youtube.title: Why we made a busy septic company's service area smaller
youtube.description:
Six weeks in, this septic company is buying two new pump trucks. So why shrink the map? A big ad budget spread across a big service area pays for calls from towns you don't want to drive to. Pull it in closer and the whole budget lands near home, where the jobs are close.

#septic #septicbusiness #googleads #localserviceads #smallbusinessmarketing

clips.title:
Raise your prices
a *little*

youtube.title: Your customer won't feel a small price increase. Your margin will.
youtube.description:
Investors handed one of our septic clients a list of changes, and raising prices was on it. They were right. A small increase barely registers with the customer, but over a year it becomes the cushion that covers the surprises.

#septic #pricing #smallbusiness #servicebusiness #profitmargin

youtube.title: The question to ask before you invest more in marketing
youtube.description:
A septic client wants to invest more with us. Before they did, one of the owners asked whether I'll still be the one handling their account. When both companies are growing, the relationship has to be planned on purpose.

#septic #marketingagency #smallbusinessowner #septicbusiness

youtube.title: How a new website quietly loses leads on launch day
youtube.description:
A septic client was nervous about switching websites, and they had a point. Launch day is when a form can look fine and send nowhere. Before you switch, ask your designer how they'll prove your forms work on day one.

#septic #websitedesign #smallbusinessmarketing #leadgeneration

youtube.title: The number that matters more than your cost per click
youtube.description:
We went through two septic client accounts with a Google Ads strategist. The target: a customer worth about three times what you paid to get them. Once you know a customer's lifetime value, you know what you can afford to pay for one. Comment "value" and I'll send you the simple version.

#septic #googleads #ppc #customerlifetimevalue #smallbusinessmarketing
